naslov: Cleveland takes on Washington following overtime win
tekst:
Washington Wizards (2-2, eighth in the Eastern Conference) vs. Cleveland Cavaliers (2-1, sixth in the Eastern Conference)
              Cleveland; Wednesday, 7 p.m. EDT
              BOTTOM LINE: Cleveland hosts the Washington Wizards after the Cavaliers took down the Minnesota Timberwolves 127-125 in overtime.
              Cleveland finished 52-30 overall, 33-19 in Eastern Conference action and 27-14 at home during the 2025-26 season. The Cavaliers averaged 119.5 points per game last season, 52.0 in the paint, 18.4 off of turnovers and 14.3 on fast breaks.
              Washington finished 17-65 overall and 11-41 in Eastern Conference action during the 2025-26 season. The Wizards averaged 8.0 steals, 5.5 blocks and 15.1 turnovers per game last season.
              INJURIES: Cavaliers: Nae'Qwan Tomlin: out (back), Khalifa Diop: out (knee).
              Wizards: AJ Dybantsa: out (ankle), Tristan Vukcevic: out (hip), Jamir Watkins: out for season (acl), Justin Champagnie: day to day (foot).
